# NVIDIA Optical Flow SDK

Vendored headers from NVIDIA Optical Flow SDK 5.0.7.

## Source
- Official repository: https://github.com/NVIDIA/NVIDIAOpticalFlowSDK
- Downloaded from NVIDIA Developer Portal: Optical Flow SDK 5.0.7

## Files
- `nvOpticalFlowCommon.h` – Common definitions and error codes
- `nvOpticalFlowCuda.h` – CUDA interface
- `nvOpticalFlowD3D11.h` – Direct3D 11 interface
- `nvOpticalFlowD3D12.h` – Direct3D 12 interface (used by Cyberpunk VR port)
- `nvOpticalFlowVulkan.h` – Vulkan interface
